mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% triggers a risk premium adjustment that elevates S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the prior month's average (t-test p > 0.05) during inflation spikes above 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 0.5% is associated with higher wage growth expectations, which elevates S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by more than 0.5% from the prior month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns show no significant deviation from the mean during such labor cost increases (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in GDPC1 personal consumption exceeding 2% suggests strengthening demand, which predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative despite GDPC1 growth above 2% (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO manufacturing production index below -1% indicates supply-side weakness, which is expected to depress S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically lower than average during INDPRO declines of at least -1% (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 4%, the increased discount rate reduces expected equity present value, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during FEDFUNDS > 4% periods.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE decline below 4% signals weaker labor market expectations, which interacts with HOUST housing momentum to drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect rank IC < 0.05 but 20-day forward returns are not negative (p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of RSAFS declining by at least 10% indicate persistent monetary tightening, which is expected to produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decreases by ≥10% in two consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns fail to outperform the prior 60-day average during such RSAFS declines (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS increases by more than 1% while UNRATE remains below 6%, it suggests labor market expansion without wage inflation, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS up > 1% and UNRATE < 6% in the current month
regime_hint: labor market expansion without wage pressure
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not positive despite the combined signal (p > 0.05).
